name: dealer-store-positioning
description: Generate a comprehensive positioning brief and marketing-team-ready content kit for a car dealership. Includes positioning statement, target customer, value proposition, differentiation, voice and tone, brand promise, we-are/we-are-not boundaries, boilerplate language (3 lengths), tagline options, social media bio templates, email signature templates, value proposition variants, and pre-approved language guidelines. Foundational skill: every other marketing skill in the marketplace references the positioning output as input.
